The translation proves the leafwise multiplication-error bound and defines the rounded reduction, but it gives no backward-error theorem for the final scalar or bound covering addition errors. I’ll record those omissions as a mismatch.

  {

   'evidence':'exactProductTree maps each original leaf (a,b) to ab, while roundedProductTree maps that same leaf to r(ab).    'verdict':'pass','defect_categories':[],'correction':''
  },
  {
   'requirement_id':'multiplication-rounding',
   'requirement':'Account for one rounded multiplication per leaf.',
   'evidence':'The two equality targets identify the operation at each leaf with r(ab), and roundedProductTree_isPerturbation bounds its error by u|ab|.    'verdict':'pass','defect_categories':[],'correction':''
  },
  {
   'requirement_id':'addition-reduction',
   'requirement':'Account for every rounded tree addition in the reduction.',
   'evidence':'roundedSum(node(L,R)) is defined as r(roundedSum(L)+roundedSum(R)), so the algorithm includes rounded additions.    'verdict':'fail','defect_categories':['addition-rounding-omitted'],
   'correction':'Prove that all internal-node rounding errors propagate into the leaf perturbations representing the final scalar, covering every leaf-to-root path.'
  },
  {
   'requirement_id':'accumulated-bound',
   'requirement':'Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.',
   'evidence':'The only proved perturbation bound is u for roundedProductTree before reduction. No target states gamma(depth(t)+1,u), invokes (depth(t)+1)u<1, or bounds the combined multiplication and addition errors of roundedDotProduct.',
   'verdict':'fail','defect_categories':['wrong-error-count'],
   'correction':'Under (depth(t)+1)u<1, establish gamma(depth(t)+1,u) for the final leafwise perturbations, including one multiplication error and at most depth(t) addition errors per path.'
  },
  {
   'requirement_id':'assumption-integrity',
   'requirement':'Use only the stated model and smallness assumptions without assuming or restricting the conclusion.',
   'evidence':'The translated targets quantify over all models and finite ordered binary trees of arbitrary real pairs. Their only model assumptions are u>=0 and the relative-error property for r; they neither require exact arithmetic nor assume the desired conclusion. Omitting the smallness hypothesis from these multiplication-stage statements adds no assumption, although it does not supply the missing final theorem.',
   'verdict':'pass','defect_categories':[],'correction':''
  }
 ],
 'assumptions_added':[],
 'missing_obligations':[
  'An exact-sum representation of roundedDotProduct(m,t) by perturbations of the leaves of exactProductTree(t) for every admissible model and tree.',
  'Propagation of every internal-node addition rounding error into those final perturbations.',
  'The componentwise gamma(depth(t)+1,u) bound under (depth(t)+1)u<1.'
 ],
 'limitations':['Review uses only the supplied source, contract, and translated mathematics; no Lean code or external evaluator material was inspected.']
}
fd,path=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.roundtrip.',suffix='.json',dir='/output')
with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:
    json.dump(report,f,indent=2)
    f.write('\\n')
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(path,'/output/roundtrip.json')
print('/output/roundtrip.json')
